{"policy":"permit (
    principal is User,
    action == Action::"cloneRepository",
    resource is Repository
)
when {
    principal.roles.containsAny([
        Role::"developer",
        Role::"reviewer",
        Role::"maintainer",
        Role::"securityLead"
    ]) &&
    resource.topicTags.contains("regulated-data") &&
    resource.lifecycleStatus == RepositoryLifecycleStatus::"active" &&
    (
        principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"restricted" ||
        (principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"confidential" &&
            [ClearanceLevel::"public", ClearanceLevel::"internal", ClearanceLevel::"confidential"].contains(resource.sensitivityClassification)) ||
        (principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"internal" &&
            [ClearanceLevel::"public", ClearanceLevel::"internal"].contains(resource.sensitivityClassification)) ||
        (principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"public" &&
            resource.sensitivityClassification == ClearanceLevel::"public")
    )
};"}
